parts.name: foam-cap-top
parts.model_overhangs_review: This exact corrected-foot Mark2 +Z/floor-down top-cap slice contains no support body or interface island. Its floor lies on the bed; full cup walls, conduit/attachment columns and all four revised pump columns rise vertically from it. The cup mouth and blind insert bores open upward, and through-bores retain open axial access. There is no enclosed supported cavity to clean. Flat lid-bearing faces and the complete 6.1 mm stock below the blind insert bores are retained. This zero-support reading does not measure warping, insertion force or strength.

native_log_diagnostics_review: The only native diagnostics are saved-profile control tokens: T1001 hotend-type detection and T65535/T65279 end-code control/unload. They remain in the exact ledger. Native review verifies the intended machine/nozzle/filament mapping and completed output; no separate geometry diagnostic is present.
review_scope: This exact corrected-foot Mark2 v2 top-cap archive only. Its actual zero-support topology and null build-up fields are preserved. No prior slice approval is inherited; physical finish and fit are trial outcomes.
